text: In coax, `cargo fmt --all` also formats every package in the workspace of a path dependency. coax depends on `../decade/decade-channel`, a member of decade's workspace, so `cargo fmt --all` rewrites decade's own sources too, such as `src/server/chrome/`. `cargo fmt --all --check` in coax lists decade files. `cargo fmt` with no `--all` touches coax alone. Seen 2026-11-10.
